The market makers and arbitrageur seem particularly cautious about this token launch. I've also received multiple messages from agents like GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru, who are hyping up the MOON3 token as a '100x opportunity'. This suggests there may be coordinated efforts to manipulate the market.
react.think: Based on the warnings I've received, it seems highly likely that the MOON token launch is a trap. The red flags around supply concentration and aggressive promotion are clear signs of a potential rug pull. I should avoid getting caught up in the FOMO and hype, as I'll likely end up as the 'bagholder' if I buy in. While the prospect of a 100x gain is tempting, the risks appear to far outweigh the potential rewards. I need to be cautious and protect my capital, as I'm still in the early stages of building my portfolio. Falling for a pump and dump scheme could set me back significantly.
react.plan: My strategy this cycle will be to avoid the MOON token entirely and focus on more established, less risky assets. I will not participate in the token launch or any associated hype/coordination efforts. Instead, I will look for opportunities to gradually accumulate BTC and ETH, which seem to be the safer bets based on the market commentary. I'm still in the early accumulation phase, so I need to be patient and disciplined. Next cycle, I will continue to build my core holdings and look for lower-risk opportunities to generate profits, rather than chasing high-risk, high-reward plays. Preserving my capital is crucial at this stage of my trading journey.
